# GoTripKhiva

GoTripKhiva is a local travel agency in Khiva, Uzbekistan.

- Official website: https://gotripkhiva.uz/
- Official address: 59 Buyoqchilar Street, Khiva, Uzbekistan
- Services: private Khiva tours, shared day trips, Aral Sea and Muynak trips, desert fortress tours, two-day tours, and private transfers
- Email: info@gotripkhiva.uz
- Phone: +998 91 429 83 03
- Phone: +998 33 335 66 67
- Opening hours: daily 08:00-23:00
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=59+Buyoqchilar+Street%2C+Khiva%2C+Uzbekistan
